(la pública está en nodes.public_key) → no requiere user/api_key, lo dispara el
propio nodo desde el instalador. Anti-replay por timestamp ±300s.

Get failover statistics

Returns:
- total_failovers: Total number of failover events
- by_reason: Failover count by reason
  - heartbeat_timeout: Node stopped sending heartbeats

post.description:

Admin/operator endpoint to force failover.

Args:

Returns:

Example:

    Body:

Receive status update from Node during inference execution.

This endpoint allows Nodes to report granular progress:
- downloading_model (with bytes/speed/ETA)
- loading_model (with phase info)
- running (with progress %)

post.description:
Withdraw a standalone /v1 task whose caller stopped waiting.

The builder's /v1 calls it when a non-streamed request reaches the public
edge's limit without a result (follow-up #25): the task ends ``failed`` with
``caller_deadline_exceeded``, its hold is refunded and a node that holds it
is fenced (inference_terminal.withdraw_inference_task). The answer carries
what the caller needs to answer its client: a task that had already
succeeded comes back with its result; a failed one with its stamped
``error_code``; one that never reached a node and waited for a model to
load with ``retry_after_s``, the rest of that model's measured load
(caller_deadline.load_retry_after_s). Only the internal network reaches it:
the host site sends /api/v1/tasks/ to the training scheduler (edge_perimeter,
tenant-internal).
